name: State-Action Trajectory Validation
description: I replaced the clean algebraic inequality C(v) = v(2s-1) with an asymmetric multi-step state machine. The state Z updates via Z = 2Z + 1 when a parameter's condition is violated, and remains unchanged otherwise. While mathematically equivalent to checking if both literals are false (which yields Z=3), the sequential recurrence hides the boolean disjunction and prevents models from trivially factoring the problem into 2-SAT clauses via surface-level algebraic pattern matching.
